long_description:
Grab your mat and join us for a restorative vinyasa yoga flow at HOMES Campus!

About this Event

Join yoga instructor Susan Todoroff at HOMES Campus for an hour of slow-flow vinyasa! Ticket price includes a beverage voucher for a post-class drink of choice from Dozer Coffee or the HOMES Campus bar.

Susan Todoroff has been teaching yoga for over 20 years and is happy to bring slow-flow vinyasa style yoga to HOMES Campus this winter! Connecting dynamic movement with breath and focus, along with inspiring music, you’ll leave feeling calm and rejuvenated at the same time.

Taproom Yoga takes place in a small private room off our main taproom seating area.

Also check out other Health & Wellness events in Ann Arbor, Workshops in Ann Arbor.
